result.note: Tests the venue and forum of NASA's invitation, the Moon Base programme's lunar target, and NISAR as context.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, NASA invited ISRO to join its Moon Base programme. Consider the following statements:
items: The invitation was extended at the ninth meeting of the India-US Civil Space Joint Working Group, held in Bengaluru.
The Moon Base programme aims to establish a sustained human presence near the north pole of the moon.
NISAR, a joint NASA-ISRO Earth observation satellite, was launched in July 2025.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the programme targets a sustained human presence near the moon's south pole, not the north pole. The two sides also agreed to advance talks on sharing open scientific data under the Artemis Accords.
questions.source: The invite was extended at the ninth meeting of the India-US Civil Space Joint Working Group at ISRO headquarters in Bengaluru on August 5 and 6.
